hook: Arthur Conan Doyle began the journey of his famous detective in a Southsea office in 1886.

sections.voiceover: Arthur Conan Doyle began the journey of his famous detective in a Southsea office in 1886.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of an 1880s medical ledger and a quill pen resting on a wooden desk.
sections.sfx_cue: Scratching of a quill on parchment.

sections.voiceover: He started writing A Study in Scarlet while waiting for patients in Portsmouth, England. But what was the reality behind the fictional 221B Baker Street address in London?
sections.visual_cue: Map animation zooming from Edinburgh down to Southsea, Portsmouth.
b_roll: University of Edinburgh 1881 graduation register image

sections.voiceover: Yet, this famous address was merely a fictional flat shared by two iconic literary characters.
sections.visual_cue: Silhouette of two men standing in a Victorian-style doorway.

sections.voiceover: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson first appeared in Beeton's Christmas Annual in December 1887.
sections.visual_cue: Faded, public domain cover of an 1887 periodical.
b_roll: Beeton's Christmas Annual 1887 cover art (public domain)

sections.voiceover: Conan Doyle officially introduced this iconic duo to the world in December 1887.
sections.visual_cue: Portrait of Arthur Conan Doyle, public domain.
